layout_and_spacing.whitespace: Generous spacing philosophy applied. Use gap-12, p-12 where applicable.

hero_section.style: Minimalist, left-aligned or centered with ample white space. The background should be primarily white (#FFFFFF) with a soft butter yellow (#FFF9E6) gradient blob or shape. Remove dramatic dark elements. Convert any emoji trinkets into clean, pill-shaped UI tags (bg-white border border-[#E5E7EB] text-sm).

case_study_cards.style: Clean, rectangular or slightly rounded (rounded-3xl) cards with solid white or butter-yellow (#FFF9E6) background. No heavy dropshadows by default, use a 1px subtle border (border-[#E5E7EB]). Hover effect: slight lift (-translate-y-2), subtle shadow (shadow-xl), and border color darkens slightly.

navigation.style: Glassmorphism with optical clarity: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80, 1px bottom border (border-[#E5E7EB]). Fixed top, z-50.

buttons.primary: bg-[#1A1A1A] text-white hover:bg-[#333333] rounded-full px-8 py-4 transition-colors font-medium text-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-[#FFF9E6] text-[#1A1A1A] hover:bg-[#FACC15] rounded-full px-8 py-4 transition-colors border border-[#FACC15] font-medium text-sm

about_me.style: Circular profile picture with a delicate 1px border. Lots of whitespace. Text should be large and airy.

motion.page_transition: Framer motion fade in (opacity 0 to 1) and slight slide up (y: 20 to 0) for route changes.
